name: The Lord of Blackrock

narrative.details: The old feeling returns. The welcome pangs of victory reverberate throughout your being. Before you lies the monolithic, battle scarred head of Nefarian. Return it to your Warchief, champion.
narrative.objectives: Return the Head of Nefarian to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
narrative.offerRewardText: You have honored the Horde once more, adventurer. The son of Deathwing lays dead. Surely, the evil one stirs.
narrative.requestItemsText: I wish that I could have been there to see the look on the face of the beast as you struck the killing blow, adventurer.
